name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd
tagline: India's only fully-integrated maker of precision thermostatic bimetals, low-ohmic shunt resistors and related components for EVs, smart meters and switchgear - genuine niche moat and strong return ratios, but the stock has already run ~3x off its 52-week low and trades at a rich ~60x P/E.
business_overview: Incorporated 1984, New Delhi-headquartered (NSE/BSE ticker SBCL). Manufactures thermostatic bimetal/trimetal strips and components, low-ohmic shunt resistors, silver contacts, bus-bar connectors and PCBA assemblies - precision sensing/switching/thermal-control components used across EVs, smart meters, switchgear and energy-storage systems. Positioned as India's only fully integrated domestic manufacturer across this component set.
fundamentals_narrative: Strong, quality return ratios (ROCE ~26.6%, ROE ~21.8%) backed by a genuine structural tailwind - EV, smart-meter and switchgear electrification content growth - and a credible niche moat as the only fully integrated domestic manufacturer of this component set. The catch is valuation: the stock has already re-rated roughly 3x off its 52-week low to a ~60x trailing P/E and ~13x book, i.e. the electrification story looks largely priced in already. Detailed revenue-growth and debt figures were not fully available in this pass (screener.in page did not surface them in search snippets), but the return-ratio and valuation picture is clear enough to call.
technical_read: Trading near its 52-week high (~Rs 1,112 vs high ~Rs 1,216), following a large run-up from the 52-week low of ~Rs 369 - momentum is strong but the stock is extended, not at a fresh entry point.
sentiment_summary: No ValuePickr thread search performed this pass - four-box score (2.5) lands in the 'defaults neither unless explicit exception' band and the rich valuation argues against spending forum-read budget here.
bse_notes: No red flags found - no SEBI enforcement, promoter-pledge, auditor-resignation, or going-concern signal surfaced in this pass.
bull_case: Genuine niche moat: India's only fully integrated manufacturer of precision thermostatic bimetals, shunt resistors and related components
Real structural tailwind from EV, smart-meter and switchgear/energy-storage electrification content growth
bear_case: Valuation already rich at ~60x trailing P/E and ~13x book, after a ~3x run from the 52-week low - most of the electrification tailwind looks priced in
Small, niche end-market - scale-up ceiling versus a large-cap component supplier is unclear without further data
Revenue growth and debt detail not confirmed this pass; narrative rests mainly on return ratios and valuation multiples
verdict_headline: Quality niche electrification-component maker with a real moat and strong returns, but already re-rated ~3x to a rich ~60x P/E - four-box score (2.5) lands in the default-neither band with no explicit growth-math exception written. thesis_fit 'neither', conviction Medium.

four_box.note: Real electrification tailwind and a credible sole-integrated-manufacturer moat, but valuation is rich (~60x P/E, ~13x book) after a ~3x run off the 52-week low - defaults to 'neither' per the 2.0-2.5 rule, no exception written.

quality_metrics.note: ROCE has declined every year from a FY23 peak (38% -> 34% -> 26% -> 25% FY26) while revenue has been essentially flat (Rs 420 Cr FY23 -> Rs 462 Cr FY26, +6.9%/-2.7%/+5.7% YoY) despite continued capex - growth has not followed the capex, an efficiency caution the original 'strong return ratios' framing did not capture. IMPORTANT SEPARATE FINDING: promoter shareholding has fallen sharply, 60.6% (FY23) -> 51.1% (FY24) -> 33.4% (FY26) - a ~27pp decline that reads as a promoter-holding reduction significant enough to flag for a HIGH CAUTION review; this light-coverage pass does not have authority to set red_flag_tier, so it is surfaced here and in analysis.md for the next full pass/vpscreen-scan to assess.
